marketTone: Wednesday was an earnings rebound for the Nasdaq, a lower WTI settle beside a closer Middle East trigger, and a French 10-year through 5.0%. The S&P 500 rose 0.58% to 7757.17, WTI fell 0.68% to 97.15, and UK CPI rose to 3.5%. The chart is the average 12-month S&P return after US midterms, drawn at 15%.

summary.text: 华尔街见闻: the Dow rose 0.69% to 52856.09, the S&P 500 rose 0.58% to 7757.17, and the Nasdaq rose 1.05% to 26702.858.
华尔街见闻: December WTI fell 0.68% to 97.15 dollars a barrel and December Brent settled at 108.82 dollars. The 10-year yield was 5.1253%, up 1.68bp, and the 2-year yield was 4.8038%, up 2.77bp.

华尔街见闻: the Shanghai Composite fell 0.60% to 3713.03 and the ChiNext index fell 1.62% to 2694.71. 新华社: the Hang Seng fell 0.9% to 23651.87 and the Hang Seng Tech index fell 1.26% to 3994.77. 新浪财经: the Nikkei rose 0.85% to 64621.24 and the Kospi rose 3.29% to 5735.66.
华尔街见闻: the French 10-year yield rose through 5.0% for the first time since 2002. 英国统计局: September CPI rose to 3.5% from 3.1%, and motor fuels made the largest upward contribution.

signal: WTI at 97.15 and Brent at 108.82 are still a Strait tape after diplomats were ordered out of Saudi Arabia. The French 10-year went through 5.0%. UK CPI rose to 3.5% from 3.1% on motor fuels. Meta narrowed its 2026 capex guide to 1350亿 to 1450亿美元 and reported quarterly revenue of 646.01亿美元. The 10-year yield was 5.1253%.
watch: The Bank of Korea decides today. MOFCOM briefs at 15:00 Beijing. US jobless claims are at 20:30 and the Conference Board leading index is at 22:00, with the euro-area consumer confidence flash at the same hour. Procter & Gamble and Western Digital report. The FOMC decision is 02:00 Beijing on 29 October.

themeCards.title: Oil settled lower while the military trigger moved closer
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：WTI 12月原油期货收跌0.68%，报97.15美元/桶，布伦特12月原油期货报108.82美元/桶。 见闻称美国向中东增派第三艘航母，伊朗外长警告新一轮战争可能爆发。
themeCards.mechanism: The 97.15 settle came after a volatile session, and the military trigger moved closer with a third carrier and an Iranian warning. CICC (14 September): low inventories make the short-term risk premium more elastic when traffic through the Strait tightens. Oil carries the 97.15 and 108.82 settles. The theme changes if attacks on tankers stop and Brent settles below 108.82.
themeCards.trigger: WTI at 97.15 and Brent at 108.82, with a third carrier group reported heading to the Middle East.
themeCards.invalidator: Attacks on tankers stop and Brent settles below 108.82.

themeCards.title: The French 10-year yield went through 5%
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：法国10年期国债收益率2002年来首次升破5.0%，与德债收益率差创15年来最宽。 盘中法德利差一度扩大到约159个基点。

factSources.label: 华尔街见闻 10月22日会员早报

themeCards.mechanism: A French 10-year yield through 5.0% is a wider budget premium, and the desk called the France-Germany spread the widest in 15 years. CICC (12 October): the 2027 budget can still pass, but how much fiscal adjustment survives decides how far this premium comes back. OATs carry the 5.0% yield. The theme changes if the French 10-year falls back below 5.0%.
themeCards.trigger: The French 10-year yield through 5.0%, with the spread the widest in 15 years.

themeCards.title: Meta lifted the floor of its spending guide and planned a new share
themeCards.fact: 律动：Meta将全年资本开支指引收窄至1350亿至1450亿美元，此前为1300亿至1450亿美元，第三季度营收646.01亿美元。 华尔街见闻：Meta拟发行一类无投票权新股，用于资本融资。

factSources.label: 华尔街见闻 10月22日会员早报

themeCards.mechanism: Raising the floor of the spending guide and creating a non-voting share is equity funding for a build whose cash generation is already tight. CICC (12 October): operating cash flow at the large US AI firms is already near capital spending, so the build draws on both equity and debt. US equities and credit carry the higher floor and the 646.01亿美元 quarter. The theme changes if that floor is cut back below the new guide.
themeCards.trigger: A 2026 capex guide of 1350亿至1450亿美元 and quarterly revenue of 646.01亿美元, with a new non-voting share class.
themeCards.invalidator: The capex floor is cut back below the new guide.

themeCards.title: UK inflation reaccelerated on motor fuels
themeCards.fact: 英国统计局：9月CPI同比升至3.5%，前值为3.1%，交通运输尤其是车用燃料是最大上行贡献。 财经早茶：汽油和柴油价格飙升推动英国通胀率升至11个月高位，英国长期国债上涨。
themeCards.mechanism: Motor fuels led the rise from 3.1% to 3.5%, so the reacceleration is an energy print. CICC (20 September): UK inflation has spent most of the past five years above the Bank's target, and the Bank may have to raise rates. Gilts carry the 3.5% print, and long gilts rose on the day the hike case strengthened. The theme changes if CPI is reprinted at or below 3.1%.
themeCards.trigger: CPI at 3.5% after 3.1%, with motor fuels the largest upward contribution.
themeCards.invalidator: CPI is reprinted at or below 3.1%.

themeCards.title: Nickel rose a fourth day on a reported Indonesia cut
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：镍价四连涨，中国生产商可能协调削减印尼产量，推动供应趋紧的预期升温。
themeCards.mechanism: A fourth daily rise on a reported coordinated cut is a supply story in the metal. CICC (1 May): higher ore and sulphur costs, plus tighter Indonesian quotas, can support the nickel price. Nickel carries that four-day rise. The theme changes if the producers do not cut output and the rally ends.
themeCards.trigger: A fourth daily rise tied to a reported coordinated cut in Indonesia.
themeCards.invalidator: The producers do not cut output and the rally ends.

globalRegime: Wednesday's tape was a Nasdaq rebound on AI earnings, a lower WTI settle beside a closer Middle East trigger, and a French 10-year through 5%. UK CPI reaccelerated on motor fuels. China equity weakness sat next to an offshore yuan that the breakfast put back through 6.68. The chart is the average post-midterm S&P return.

globalChanged.text: 财经早茶：Meta加码押注AI，上调全年资本支出预测并拟发行新类别股票，股价盘后上涨。而特斯拉上季度资本支出远逊预期并下调全年支出目标，向AI和机器人企业转型的计划面临考验，其股价盘后下跌。
财经早茶：德州仪器本季度营收展望高于分析师预期，得益于汽车和工业用芯片需求。IBM上季度营收增长超预期，受基础设施订单回流提振。
财经早茶：随着也门胡塞武装带来的威胁加剧，美国国务院下令非必要外交人员及其家属撤离沙特阿拉伯。沙特阿美位于沙特东部省的谢巴油田周三遭无人机袭击，造成两人死亡。
财经早茶：据报伊朗威胁称，如果再发生造成伊朗官员和平民死亡的袭击，德黑兰将考虑把美国政治目标作为打击目标。
财经早茶：数据显示，虽然伊朗加大对途经霍尔木兹海峡的商船袭击，但中东地区石油运输已逐渐恢复到接近战前水平。
财经早茶：俄罗斯副总理表示，可能在年底前全面恢复柴油出口，首艘柴油运输船周四将启程赴美。普京表示，莫斯科准备好在11月与美国和乌克兰举行新一轮和平谈判。
财经早茶：收益率飙升冲击信贷市场，本月以来欧美企业总计推迟逾50亿美元的债务融资计划。
财经早茶：SpaceX债券下跌，市场对该公司可能进一步举债的担忧令其信用风险指标恶化。
财经早茶：法国10年期国债收益率自2002年以来首次升至5%，与德债收益率差创15年来最宽，反映市场对财政前景担忧加剧。
财经早茶：马克龙称外国领导人借法国骚乱谋求政治目的，暗指特朗普和内塔尼亚胡拿法国事态做竞选文章。
财经早茶：彭博调查显示，逾八成日本央行观察人士预计该行下一次加息将在12月份，近七成受访者预计今后将每三个月加息一次。
财经早茶：日本多家寿险公司计划在本财年下半年维持或增加对日本债券的购买，此举料为日本国债市场提供支撑。
财经早茶：汽油和柴油价格飙升推动英国通胀率升至11个月高位，央行加息预期升温。
财经早茶：包括德银、贝莱德CEO在内的多位金融和投资界高管对AI泡沫论提出异议，呼吁加快数据中心建设。

globalImplies.text: If the third carrier arrives and tanker attacks continue, Brent can move back through 108.82 after Wednesday's lower WTI settle.
If the French 10-year stays through 5.0%, OATs hold a budget premium while the 2027 budget is still in politics.
If motor fuels keep leading UK CPI above 3.1%, the hike case for gilts stays in place even though long gilts rose on the day.

globalTensions: WTI settled at 97.15 on a day the mail said oil shipments through the Strait were moving back toward pre-war levels, while diplomats left Saudi Arabia and a field was hit. The Nasdaq rose 1.05% while SpaceX bonds fell and companies postponed debt sales. The French 10-year broke 5.0% while long gilts rose with UK CPI at 3.5%. Gold was only slightly higher on the breakfast tape.
chinaStance: A PBOC official said the next step is a larger supply of RMB assets that foreigners can hold for a long time. SAMR pressed ecommerce platforms on product quality, and Alibaba was the drag the mail named in China ADRs. Offshore yuan on the breakfast broke 6.68 again. The nickel cut talk is a supply story, not a rate move. LPR was not revisited on this tape.

chinaChanged.text: 财经早茶：中国市场监管总局敦促电商平台提升产品和服务质量，称直播带货等场景存在质量安全风险，阿里巴巴等中国电商ADR下跌。

chinaChanged.text: 财经早茶：中国央行官员表示，下一步央行将进一步丰富全球优质人民币资产供给，要让境外主体觉得人民币方便持有，可以长期持有。
财经早茶：克里姆林宫最高外交政策助理透露，北京已开始为下个月潜在的首次中美俄元首会晤做准备。
财经早茶：中国总理李强与俄罗斯总统普京、总理米舒斯京举行会晤，两国同意推进AI、能源、经贸和金融等领域合作。
财经早茶：中国与欧盟承诺深化竞争政策和反垄断执法合作。德国总理默茨称欧盟希望避免与中国打贸易战，但会采取自卫措施。
财经早茶：加拿大贸易部长表示，中国副总理何立峰将率团前往温哥华与加方讨论金融服务问题。
财经早茶：青山控股等主要中资镍企据悉同意削减印尼工厂产量，以支撑低迷的镍价。
华尔街见闻：中共中央、国务院意见提出开展颠覆性技术挖掘甄别，并探索沙盒监管。
华尔街见闻：离岸人民币再破6.68，连续五日创四年新高。
华尔街见闻：数字人民币运营管理中心发布央行端系统和智能合约生态服务框架。
财新：宁德时代21日股价下跌近12%，单日市值蒸发超1400亿元。
第一财经：上交所召开首批主动ETF市场动员会，引导中长期资金入市。

chinaImplies.text: If the platform-quality push stays a meeting, the ADR drop is the tape and there is no new loan-rate move in it.
If producers do not cut Indonesian nickel output, the four-day rise loses the supply story the mail used.
If offshore yuan stays through 6.68, the holding case the PBOC official described has a price next to the speech.

chinaDivergences: Shanghai fell 0.60% and the ChiNext index fell 1.62%, a wider onshore split than Tuesday. Hang Seng Tech fell 1.26% to 3994.77. Offshore yuan broke 6.68 on a day the mail said Alibaba and JD were the drag on the China ADR index. CATL's single-name drop sat beside that, while the policy lines were a quality meeting and an RMB-asset speech, not a rate change.
